about.title: Head Baseball Coach
about.bio: With years of experience developing players from Little League through varsity and beyond, I focus on the mechanics and mental approach that build confident, consistent athletes. Every player I work with leaves with a clearer understanding of their game.

hero.headline: Build the Arm. Own the Plate.
hero.subline: Private baseball coaching — pitching mechanics, hitting development, and recruiting prep for athletes who play to win.

services.title: Pitching Mechanics
services.description: Individual sessions targeting delivery, arm path, velocity development, and command for pitchers at every level.

services.title: Hitting Development
services.description: Mechanics, pitch recognition, plate discipline — build a repeatable swing that holds up under pressure.

services.title: Position & Recruiting Prep
services.description: Fielding, throws, and baserunning for position players. Recruiting profile guidance for players targeting college ball.

testimonials.quote: My son went from a struggling JV pitcher to the team's Friday night starter after working on his mechanics. The improvement was dramatic.
testimonials.name: Robert K.

testimonials.quote: The hitting sessions gave me a completely new approach to the plate. I cut my strikeouts in half and doubled my hard contact.

success_stories.name: Noah C.
success_stories.story: Noah had a live arm but inconsistent mechanics that were creating command issues and risking arm health. We rebuilt his delivery over one off-season, adding velocity and significantly improving his strike percentage.
success_stories.result: Varsity Starter · 4 mph Velocity Gain · Signed D2

faq.question: What age groups do you train?
faq.answer: We work with players from 7 years old through college level. Sessions are tailored to current skill level and goals.

faq.question: Where do sessions take place?
faq.answer: Training is conducted at local fields and cage facilities in the area. Location is confirmed at booking.

faq.question: How long are sessions?
faq.answer: Standard sessions are 60 minutes. Extended sessions (90 min) are available for players who want more volume.

faq.question: What should my player bring?
faq.answer: Glove, cleats, helmet and bat (if a hitter), and water. Baseballs and training equipment are provided.

faq.question: Do you help with recruiting exposure?
faq.answer: Yes — for high school players targeting college ball, I provide guidance on recruiting profiles, video, and outreach strategy.
